text.p: Following is a list of appearances before parliamentary committees this week:
MONDAY, Nov 25
- Establishment of a special commission on psychotropic
drugs (meeting all week).
TUESDAY Nov 26
- Commission II - meeting with Home Minister Yogie Memet.
- Commission IV - meeting Secretary General of Transmigration
Department.
- Budget Commission - meeting head of National Planning Agency (Bappenas)
WEDNESDAY, Nov 27
- Commission II - meeting with Home Minister.
- Commission IV - meeting with Secretary General of
Agriculture Ministry.
- Commission V - meeting with Director General of Tourism.
- Commission IX - meeting with Minister for Religious
Affairs.
- Budget Commission - meeting with Finance Minister Mar'ie
Muhammad.
THURSDAY, Nov 28
- Budget Commission - meeting with Finance Minister.
FRIDAY, Nov 29
- Psychotropic drugs commission (continuing from Monday).
